admin_brackets_has_results_description: Deleting it would erase results that happened on the court. To redo the draw, undo the scores first, from the final back to the first round.

admin_brackets_preview_already_drawn: This sport has already been drawn in this category. To redo it, delete the current bracket.
admin_brackets_preview_not_enough: At least 2 classes with the minimum number of athletes are needed. Ask the advisors and representatives to complete the lists.
admin_brackets_row_delete_description: The bracket's matches are deleted and registrations open again. A bracket with a score entered cannot be deleted.
admin_brackets_empty_description: Add classes and sports, let the classes register their athletes, and draw each sport's bracket by category.

admin_removals_empty: No athlete has been removed from a sport.
admin_matches_empty_description: Matches come from each bracket's draw: draw a sport in a category and the matches show up here. The winner moves on to the next round on its own.
admin_announcements_field_pinned: Pin to the top of the site
admin_announcements_field_pinned_descrip: A pinned announcement appears before the others.
admin_announcements_remove_description: It disappears from the site right away. This cannot be undone.
admin_announcements_empty_description: Schedule, venue or rule changes: the announcement shows up on the site as soon as it is created.
admin_classrooms_description: The classes that compete in the games. Each one forms one team per sport; the category comes from the grade.
admin_classrooms_load_error: Could not load the classes right now.
admin_classrooms_empty: No classes in this category yet.
admin_classrooms_remove_description: Its students and registrations are deleted with it. This cannot be undone.
admin_classrooms_field_name_description: This is the name shown on the scoreboard.
admin_classrooms_field_grade_description: Grades 3 to 5 are Fundamental 1; grades 6 to 9 are Fundamental 2.
admin_classrooms_field_representative_de: Accounts come from Users, with the representative role.
admin_sports_field_name_description: It becomes the sport's address on the site.
admin_sports_field_min_description: A class with fewer registered athletes is left out of the draw.
admin_sports_remove_description: Only possible while no class has registered athletes in it. This cannot be undone.
admin_sports_empty_description: Futsal, volleyball, dodgeball… each with a minimum and maximum number of athletes per team.
admin_photos_description: The photos in the site carousel. Advisors' photos only appear after they are approved here.
admin_photos_upload_description: A photo from the organizers goes straight to the site.
admin_photos_approved: Photo approved: it is already on the site.
admin_photos_rejected: Photo rejected: it is off the site.
admin_photos_delete_description: It disappears from the site and from the sender's list. This cannot be undone.
admin_reports_description: Who took part in the games. An athlete is a student registered in at least one sport.
admin_site_description: What appears in "About the games" and in the site footer, plus the rulebook to download. An empty field does not appear on the site.
admin_users_empty_description: This is the only way to create an account: there is no public sign-up, and the first administrator comes from the seeder.

match.countExact=0, countPlural=*: {count} accounts lose access to the dashboard and leave the list. They can be restored later.
match.countExact=*, countPlural=one: {count} account loses access to the dashboard and leaves the list. It can be restored later.
match.countExact=*, countPlural=*: {count} accounts lose access to the dashboard and leave the list. They can be restored later.

admin_users_archive_description: It loses access to the dashboard and leaves the list, and can be restored later.
admin_users_restore_description: It returns to the list, in the status it had.
admin_users_remove_description: The record is deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
admin_users_create_note: The email of an archived account reactivates that record with the new data instead of creating another.
admin_users_edit_note: Changing the email or the password ends this account's open sessions.
admin_users_field_new_password: New password (leave blank to keep the current one)
admin_users_field_password_description: 8 to 32 characters, with a lowercase letter, an uppercase letter, a number and a special character.
admin_users_field_name_placeholder: Name of the person using the account
admin_users_field_email_description: It is what the person uses to sign in to the dashboard.
admin_users_field_role_description: The administrator organizes the games. The advisor looks after the students of their own classes. The representative builds the class's athlete list.
admin_users_field_status_description: An inactive account cannot sign in to the dashboard and stays in the list.
